CI-bot: [ALERT] Nightly perf-run failed for nightly/perf/2026-03-17 - throughput regression detected
- test: gen-throughput-primary
- model: rwd-model-4-quant
- baseline: 125 tok/s
- current: 96 tok/s (-23%)
Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/alerts/1778002468 :mag_right:

Maria: @team can someone grab the perf artifacts and binlogs? unsure if it's infra or model change :eyes:

Alex: I'll pull the job artifacts now. pinging @Ryan if you ran any local benchmarks yesterday.

Ryan: I ran a quick local with commit range main..HEAD yesterday, saw ~5% variance only. I'll re-run with exact nightly commit. ETA 10m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jamie: Can you also run the recommended micro-bench cmd?
```bash
./bench/run.sh --model rwd-model-4-quant --seq 1024 --tokens 10000 --batch 1
```

Maria: grabbed artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/perf/1778002468/artifacts.tar.gz. uploading flamegraphs now.

Alex: Found that the nightly used kernel lib v2.7.0 -> v2.9.1 in infra image. Rolling back to v2.8 fixed locally. suspect kernel change + kv-cache pressure.

Ryan: Re-run complete. With rollback to v2.8 I get 122 tok/s. With v2.9.1 it's 94 tok/s. Attaching perf diff gist: https://gist.github.com/ryan/abcd1234

Jamie: Ok that's actionable. Plan: (1) pin runtime image to v2.8 for nightly (2) open rollout-blocker PR to revert/patch kernels (3) add micro-bench to pre-merge for runtime changes. @Alex can you file the PR?

Alex: On it. Filing PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5123 :white_check_mark:

Maria: Also adding an automated alert rule to catch >15% drop across two runs. Will update alert docs.

CI-bot: Incident note recorded: #INC-2026-184. Marked investigating.

Jamie: Thanks all — keeping this open until next nightly validates. :thumbsup:
